LOLC Holdings profit up 10% 📈

LOLC Holdings PLC (LOLC) made a profit of Rs 8.88 billion for shareholders in the July to September 2026 quarter. That is 10% more than a year ago, and 44% more than the last quarter.

Gross income grew 16% to Rs 127.46 billion. Net interest income rose 14% to Rs 35.52 billion.

For the first six months, profit was Rs 15.06 billion, up 19%.

Source: LOLC interim financial statements, Colombo Stock Exchange, https://cdn.cse.lk/cmt/upload_report_file/378_1794560701447.pdf
